output.text: The community garden has become a lively project this spring, with everyone taking on different jobs to keep things running smoothly. Assume that Ben is the treasurer. Gus booked the hall for the planning meeting so the volunteers could gather comfortably before the planting season began. Mina is on the same team as Leo, and the two of them have been coordinating the watering schedule for the raised beds near the fence. Leo is not on the same team as Dev, which means their tasks rarely overlap during the weekly work sessions. Mina is not on the same team as Dev either, though they still chat often when picking up tools from the shed. Gus arrived earliest on Saturday morning, well before the others, since he wanted to set up chairs and unlock the storage shed. Dev is the tallest of the group, often reaching the top shelves without needing the step stool that Mina prefers. Ben, being a few years older than Leo, has taken a mentoring role when it comes to budgeting for seeds and tools. Mina ranked highest in the seedling-growing contest last month, narrowly beating Gus, who came in second. Leo tends to arrive right after Gus, usually carrying a thermos of coffee for the early workers. Dev's height comes in handy when hanging the garden's new welcome sign near the entrance gate. Everyone seems to appreciate how well the group works together, even with their varied schedules and different responsibilities around the garden.”
